methodology: Final slipstream, motorcycle presentation and Festival effects regression selection, scoped lint of the three incoming files, and source-guarded production build after preserving concurrent MotoGP commit 8f1823ee566815c0f0469c84519e9f3c57be91e8. The incoming patch changes only motorcycle drag integration; it does not change the Festival or shared application entry/render paths previously exercised at fingerprint 13a1175f3deddf9bb25dbed0efadda0da0888c8d3f9aefe13d75b8f0b9b5f283. npm run build performs full TypeScript checking and Vite production bundling. The guard compares all configured inputs before/after the build. This is not npm run check:stable and does not rerun the broad unit suite.
captureMethod: Guarded build repeated with buffered subprocess pipe capture to retain complete output. The first successful build had a replaced live log pathname that retained only its prebuild header; its original partial log and gate record are retained separately. Earlier targeted tests and lint were not repeated.
